contract.intent: Freeze the tree format (v0 bootstrap) as a locked spec — the engine's data contract. Referred from AGENTS.md (the instruction file) so every agent session honors it.
acceptanceCriteria: tree-format-spec.md artifact exists at artifacts/ covering: layout, node.json schema, events.jsonl schema + status derivation, description.md card convention, artifacts/ convention, checkpoint/RPO semantics, engine acceptance criteria, edge cases
AGENTS.md (instruction file) references the spec path
tree/README.md format-rules section points at the locked spec
